'''Roh'Saren the Red''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raider]] [[Chief/Legends|chief]] living on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] until [[3643 BBY]], when he was [[Death/Legends|killed]].

==Behind the scenes==
Roh'Saren appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as a Champion boss on Tatooine. He is not directly involved in any quests, but can be killed for loot and as part of the achievement. This article assumes 100% game completion, which means he was killed.
